## Data

```{r load-data}
# Point this at wherever FanGraphs_Batted_Ball_Splits.csv lives on your machine.
fg <- read_csv("FanGraphs_Batted_Ball_Splits.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Player))

metrics <- c("Pull%", "Cent%", "Oppo%", "GB%", "FB%", "LD%", "HR/FB", "K%")

n_pairs <- fg %>% distinct(Player, Season) %>% nrow()
n_pairs
```

## Palette

Reference palette from the dataviz skill (light mode). Swap these hex values if
you want to match a different brand/design system -- nothing else in this file
needs to change.

```{r palette}
SURFACE      <- "#fcfcfb"
INK_PRIMARY  <- "#0b0b0b"
INK_SECONDARY<- "#52514e"
INK_MUTED    <- "#898781"
GRID         <- "#e1e0d9"
BASELINE     <- "#c3c2b7"
BLUE         <- "#2a78d6"   # 2nd half higher
RED          <- "#e34948"   # 2nd half lower

base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = SURFACE, color = NA),
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = SURFACE, color = NA),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y= element_blank(),
    axis.text         = element_text(color = INK_MUTED, size = 10.5),
    axis.title        = element_text(color = INK_SECONDARY, size = 10.5),
    plot.title        = element_text(color = INK_PRIMARY, face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle     = element_text(color = INK_MUTED, size = 9.5),
    legend.position   = "none"
  )
```

## Paired 1st-half vs 2nd-half table

One row per player-season-metric, with the paired t-test and Wilcoxon
signed-rank test on the half-to-half delta (2nd half minus 1st half).

```{r paired-stats}
wide <- fg %>%
  select(Player, Season, Half, all_of(metrics)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Half, values_from = all_of(metrics))

paired_test <- function(metric) {
  h1 <- wide[[paste0(metric, "_1st")]]
  h2 <- wide[[paste0(metric, "_2nd")]]
  keep <- !is.na(h1) & !is.na(h2)
  h1 <- h1[keep]; h2 <- h2[keep]
  delta <- h2 - h1
  n <- length(delta)
  se <- sd(delta) / sqrt(n)
  ci95 <- qt(0.975, n - 1) * se
  tt <- t.test(h2, h1, paired = TRUE)
  wt <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(h2, h1, paired = TRUE))
  tibble(
    metric = metric, n = n, mean_delta = mean(delta), ci95 = ci95,
    t_p = tt$p.value, wilcoxon_p = wt$p.value
  )
}

res <- bind_rows(lapply(metrics, paired_test)) %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = rev(metrics)))

res %>% arrange(desc(metric)) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3)))

write_csv(res %>% mutate(metric = as.character(metric)),
          file.path(out_dir, "exploratory_results_table.csv"))
```

## Chart 1 -- headline summary: mean change across all 8 metrics

```{r chart-summary, fig.width=10.5, fig.height=6, dpi=200}
res_plot <- res %>%
  mutate(
    direction = ifelse(mean_delta >= 0, "up", "down"),
    sig = case_when(t_p < 0.05 ~ "*", t_p < 0.10 ~ "~", TRUE ~ ""),
    label = sprintf("%+.1f pp%s", mean_delta, sig),
    label_x = ifelse(mean_delta >= 0, mean_delta + ci95, mean_delta - ci95),
    label_hjust = ifelse(mean_delta >= 0, -0.15, 1.15)
  )

p1 <- ggplot(res_plot, aes(x = metric, y = mean_delta, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.56) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_delta - ci95, ymax = mean_delta + ci95),
                width = 0.16, color = INK_SECONDARY, linewidth = 0.55) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = BASELINE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(y = label_x, label = label, hjust = label_hjust),
            color = INK_PRIMARY, size = 3.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(up = BLUE, down = RED),
                     labels = c(up = "2nd half higher", down = "2nd half lower")) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.22)) +
  labs(
    title = "Home Run Derby participants: 1st-half -> 2nd-half batted-ball shifts",
    subtitle = paste0("FanGraphs splits, ", n_pairs, " player-seasons (2015-2026) | error bars = 95% CI\n",
                       "* p<.05, ~ p<.10 (paired t-test) | exploratory -- no control group yet"),
    x = NULL, y = "Mean change, 2nd half minus 1st half (percentage points)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = GRID, linewidth = 0.5))

p1
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "exploratory_summary_deltas.png"), p1, width = 10.5, height = 6, dpi = 200)
```

## Chart 2 -- the core hypothesis: Pull% and FB%

```{r chart-pull-fb, fig.width=10.5, fig.height=5.2, dpi=200}
paired_panel <- function(metric, title_extra = NULL) {
  h1 <- wide[[paste0(metric, "_1st")]]
  h2 <- wide[[paste0(metric, "_2nd")]]
  keep <- !is.na(h1) & !is.na(h2)
  d <- tibble(id = seq_len(sum(keep)), h1 = h1[keep], h2 = h2[keep]) %>%
    mutate(dir = ifelse(h2 >= h1, "up", "down"))
  long <- d %>% pivot_longer(c(h1, h2), names_to = "half", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(half = factor(half, levels = c("h1", "h2"), labels = c("1st half", "2nd half")))
  means <- long %>% group_by(half) %>% summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop")

  stat_row <- res %>% filter(as.character(metric) == !!metric)
  subt <- sprintf("mean %+.1f pp | t p=%.3f, W p=%.3f",
                   stat_row$mean_delta, stat_row$t_p, stat_row$wilcoxon_p)

  ggplot(long, aes(x = half, y = value, group = id)) +
    geom_line(aes(color = dir), alpha = 0.22, linewidth = 0.55) +
    geom_point(color = INK_SECONDARY, size = 1.3, alpha = 0.55) +
    geom_line(data = means, aes(x = half, y = value, group = 1),
              color = INK_PRIMARY, linewidth = 1.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = means, aes(x = half, y = value),
               color = INK_PRIMARY, size = 2.6, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(up = BLUE, down = RED)) +
    labs(title = NULL, subtitle = subt, x = NULL, y = metric) +
    base_theme +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = GRID, linewidth = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(color = INK_MUTED, size = 8.3))
}

p_pull <- paired_panel("Pull%")
p_fb   <- paired_panel("FB%")

p2 <- (p_pull | p_fb) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "The core hypothesis: more pull, more fly balls in the 2nd half?",
    subtitle = paste0("Each thin line = one player-season (n=", n_pairs, ") | bold line = mean | exploratory, no control group yet"),
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(color = INK_PRIMARY, face = "bold", size = 15),
                  plot.subtitle = element_text(color = INK_MUTED, size = 9.5))
  )
p2
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "exploratory_pull_fb_paired.png"), p2, width = 10.5, height = 5.2, dpi = 200)
```

## Notes

- This is exploratory only: `Controls.csv` (the matched non-participant All-Star
  comparison group) is still just the template row, so nothing here is a test of
  whether Derby participation *causes* anything -- it's the within-participant
  1st-half-vs-2nd-half pattern only.
- Each player-season is one pair; players who appear in multiple Derby seasons
  (e.g. Pete Alonso, Kyle Schwarber) contribute more than one pair, so
  observations aren't fully independent -- a mixed-effects model with a
  player random intercept would be the more rigorous version of this once the
  full dataset (including controls) is in.
- Re-knit this file any time `FanGraphs_Batted_Ball_Splits.csv` is updated and
  all four PNGs plus the results table will regenerate in `out_dir`.
